first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Large sections of dark teal seating arranged across the stands and divided into multiple areas by gray stepped passageways.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: The light-colored covering structure and repeating trusses above the stadium stands, distinct from the nearby passageway ceiling.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: A set of frame-shaped racing facilities near the stands, with pink-purple illuminated edges and darker interior areas.

entities.name: green stadium turf
entities.identification: The green field at the center of the stadium, enclosed by the stands.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: Rows of bright white lights spaced along the edge of the stadium roof.

entities.name: passageway floor
entities.identification: The dark, hard surface leading to the opening into the stadium, with its surface affected by purple and localized warm-colored lighting.

entities.name: passageway wall
entities.identification: The large solid wall surfaces on both sides of the passageway and to the left of the exit, with corners and darker lower edges locally visible.

entities.name: passageway ceiling
entities.identification: The dark panels above the nearby passageway and the repeating beam-like and diagonally connected structural members.

entities.name: purple-orange passageway light fixture
entities.identification: The purple linear light sources and localized orange-yellow light sources near the structures around the passageway.
